from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """
    Metadata extracted from a single judgment document relevant to cause of action filtering.
    """
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or name of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The case category/type (e.g. '民事', '行政', '刑事') derived from document headers or cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
